what: A screen-wide wordmark laid below the Hero becomes fixed as a whole the moment its top edge touches the top of the screen (no spacer). It then shrinks to .268x over .6s ease and moves up 3.5rem to become the centered header logo. Scrolling back up grows it again over the same length. It is not bound to scroll but is a CSS transition that switches once on contact

options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Wordmark to shrink (child) — this element’s top edge is the reference. A small logo above it stays pinned too and slides off above the screen
options.start: Where it gets pinned (ScrollTrigger start), default ”top top”
options.--fx-scale: Shrunk size (via style·css), default .268 — original phone version .62
options.--fx-y: Distance shifted while shrinking, default -3.5rem — original phone panel 1.5rem

use: Logo

from.where: index.html .sd-hlogo — original ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: .enlogo, pin: .logo, pinSpacing: false, start: top top, end: max }) onEnter/onLeaveBack turns data-active on, and the wordmark img goes to scale .268 · translate 0 -3.5rem (phone .62 · 0 1.5rem) with transition scale .6s ease, translate .6s ease
